note: The pass/fail rule of `bench/run.mjs compare`: a change passes only if none of these is broken. Values are defaults from analysis artifact #1 (gap 1 in docs/platform/proposals.md).

doneRate.description: The share of tasks that reached done must not fall by more than this.

returnsPerTask.description: Review returns per task must not grow by more than this.

costPerDoneTask.description: The models' cost per done task must not grow by more than this per cent.
